title: Update to 0.1.1
changelog:
Starts cleanly. The app opens straight into its dark theme instead of flashing a white screen first — the launch window was still Expo's default white.

Everything from 0.1.0 is in here too: the lighter ledger (six months, not ten years), lists that recycle rows so scrolling stays smooth, screens that keep their shape while loading instead of showing a blank page, and the fix that stopped every cold start landing on the intro.
